Shri Pradeep Gupta - Government Advocate for the responden
 Order

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the applicant for quashment of FIR bearing Crime No.641/2021 registered at Police Station Bairagarh, District Bhopal for commission of offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and all consequential proceedings pursuant thereto.
At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission to withdraw the petition.
Accordingly, this petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE @shish Surendra Kumar Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184336588/
